title: A new lathe Facing faces the part away: the seed's facing plane is Bottom of Model and its top is Top of Model, so the stock allowance is never faced

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

A lathe Facing created with its seed heights faces the part away down to its bottom, and leaves the stock allowance above the part untouched. The seed sets:

- `top_z` to Top of Model.
- `bottom_z`, the finished facing plane, to Bottom of Model.

The MCP `add_operation` creates from `operation::seed_params` (#511). The GUI's quick-add (`quick_params`) retypes the same Face draft, so it gets the same heights. Only the MCP path was run.

`generate` says `ok`. `verify` holds the post, but its words understate the cut: "0.8000 mm gouge" for passes that cut 48 mm into the part.

## Reproduction (main 38699549, `camcraft-cli mcp`)

`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/seed.rs` and `crates/motion/src/turning/face.rs` are unchanged from there to 3f6ecb4a.

The part is a plain bar, r 10 from z 0 to 48: an ASCII STL revolved from the meridian `(0,0) (10,0) (10,48) (0,48)` with 64 segments. The stock is a cylinder of 20 × 50, so 2 mm of facing allowance stands above the part.

```json
[["load_machine", {"path": "assets/machines/lathe.mch"}],
 ["import_model", {"path": "cyl.stl"}],
 ["set_stock", {"cylinder": {"diameter": 20, "height": 50}}],
 ["add_tool", {"catalog": "TN-1600-0R8"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "facing", "tool": "TN-1600-0R8", "name": "F1", "source": "cyl"}],
 ["generate", {"name": "F1"}], ["verify", {}],
 ["post", {"output": "f1.nc", "post": "assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps"}]]
```

- `get_job` shows the seed: `"top_z": {"offset": 0.0, "reference": "top_of_model"}, "bottom_z": {"offset": 0.0, "reference": "bottom_of_model"}`.
- `generate` returns `status: ok` with 487 moves. That is 97 stations at the 0.5 stepdown, from z 0 up to z 48.
- `verify` returns:
  ```
  finish envelope near move 3: 0.8000 mm gouge, 0.0092 mm rest
  rapid move 4 travels below the clearance plane inside stock
  rapid move 5 travels below the clearance plane inside stock
  ```
- `post` is refused: `post blocked - 3 warning(s): ...`

## Neighbour case that works

On the same document, `edit_operation` with `top_z` = Top of Stock and `bottom_z` = Top of Model gives 27 moves and no findings. It posts 42 lines: five passes `X-1.6` at Z50, Z49.5, Z49, Z48.5 and Z48.

## Root cause (confirmed)

`seed_facing` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`) takes `top: c.top` and `bottom: c.bottom` from `Carried::of` the seed Face. Face has neither field, so the fold's defaults fill them: `Height::of(TopOfModel, 0.0)` and `Height::of(BottomOfModel, 0.0)`. The second is the #214 choice ("the part's own floor") made for the mill kinds' depth.

For Facing that floor becomes the facing plane. `turning::facing` then ladders from `facing_z` = 0 up to `min(top_z, z_top)` = 48, so the allowance above 48 is never reached and every station below it cuts the part.

`seed_facing` already overrides the fold's stepdown for this family ("the mill default the fold carries would refuse against the house insert's 0.8 mm nose"). The heights get no such override. The test `the_facing_seed_faces_the_bar` (`crates/app/tests/turning.rs`) passes `top` and `bottom` as fixed 16 and 14 in a hand-built `Carried`, so it never meets the fold's defaults.

On the verify wording: `EnvelopeReport::gouge_mm` saturates at the ball radius by design ("a path that buried its centers in material reads the saturation value `r`"). So the reported 0.8 mm is the nose radius, not the depth cut.

## Expected

A new Facing faces the allowance down to the part's top: Top of Stock down to Top of Model, the heights of the neighbour case. When the part is already at length, it says there is nothing to face.

## Suggested labels

Outside contributors can't set labels, so these are suggestions:

- `P3`: every new Facing cuts the part away until its heights are edited. The gate catches it, so it is not P1.
- `effort:high`: a small diff (one seed in `kinds.rs`, plus a test that runs `seed_params` itself), but it changes what a new op posts, so the safety floor applies.
- `area:turning`
- `source:agent`
